keyEvents.text: Goal! Arsenal 1, Chelsea 0. William Saliba (Arsenal) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Gabriel Magalhães with a headed pass following a corner.
Own Goal by Piero Hincapié, Arsenal. Arsenal 1, Chelsea 1.
Substitution, Arsenal. Gabriel Martinelli replaces Leandro Trossard.
Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Arsenal 2, Chelsea 1. Jurriën Timber (Arsenal) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Declan Rice with a cross following a corner.
Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card.
Second yellow card to Pedro Neto (Chelsea) for a bad foul.
Gabriel Magalhães (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Roméo Lavia replaces Andrey Santos.
Substitution, Chelsea. Malo Gusto replaces Jorrel Hato.
Substitution, Arsenal. Christian Nørgaard replaces Declan Rice.
Substitution, Arsenal. Kai Havertz replaces Viktor Gyökeres.
Enzo Fernández (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Chelsea. Liam Delap replaces Enzo Fernández.
Substitution, Chelsea. Alejandro Garnacho replaces Cole Palmer.
Substitution, Chelsea. Tosin Adarabioyo replaces Mamadou Sarr.
